arms.label: Stock Copilot CLI
arms.description: Default Copilot CLI 1.0.112 with built-in tools only; no TokenMaster MCP, PostToolUse, lean launcher, or sessionStart brief.

arms.label: TokenMaster Lean (No Brief)
arms.description: TokenMaster MCP navigation + PostToolUse output reducer + --lean launcher; hooks.sessionStart disabled.

arms.label: TokenMaster + Cold Repo Brief
arms.description: tm_lean + hooks.sessionStart injecting deterministic <=320-token cold architectural brief (.token-master/brief.md: Layout + Hubs + Entrypoints; zero cross-session recall).

arms.label: TokenMaster + Warm Recall Brief
arms.description: tm_lean + hooks.sessionStart injecting <=320-token refreshed brief seeded from genuine prior-session MCP navigation logs (.token-master/recall.jsonl -> setup.py --refresh-brief).

buckets.A_cold_architecture: Symptom- and architecture-driven tasks omitting internal file paths and symbol names, targeting core repository hubs/entrypoints covered by the cold structural brief.
buckets.B_cross_session_recall: Follow-up tasks in deep subsystems absent from the cold structural top-hub list, seeded via prior-session navigation logs (recall.jsonl -> --refresh-brief) without answer leakage.
buckets.C_direct_symbol_control: Negative-control lookups that explicitly name the exact non-hub, non-recalled Class.method or function in sentence 1 so tm_lean needs zero orientation, measuring fixed brief overhead.

tasks.title: Add is_high_confidence() helper to structured evaluation validator
tasks.prompt: In the structured choice/score/noul evaluation response validator module, add a pure function `is_high_confidence(answer: ChoiceAnswer | ScoreAnswer | NoulAnswer, min_confidence: float = 0.8) -> bool`. Validate that `min_confidence` is a finite `int` or `float` (not `bool`) in `[0.0, 1.0]`, raising `ValidationError("invalid_threshold")` otherwise. For `"choice"` and `"score"` answer dicts, return `answer["confidence"] >= min_confidence`; for `"noul"` answer dicts, return `max(answer["noul"], 1.0 - answer["noul"]) >= min_confidence` (raising `ValidationError("invalid_response")` on an unknown/malformed answer dict). Modify only that validator module (do not edit test files or leave temporary files) and reply `DONE` once finished.

+def is_high_confidence(
+    answer: ChoiceAnswer | ScoreAnswer | NoulAnswer,
+    min_confidence: float = 0.8,
+) -> bool:
+    _require(_number(min_confidence) and 0.0 <= min_confidence <= 1.0, "invalid_threshold")
+    _require(type(answer) is dict, "invalid_response")
+    kind = answer.get("type")
+    if kind in ("choice", "score"):
+        conf = answer.get("confidence")
+        _require(_number(conf) and 0.0 <= conf <= 1.0, "invalid_response")
+        return bool(conf >= min_confidence)
+    if kind == "noul":
+        val = answer.get("noul")
+        _require(_number(val) and 0.0 <= val <= 1.0, "invalid_response")
+        return bool(max(val, 1.0 - val) >= min_confidence)
+    raise ValidationError("invalid_response")
+
